name: Tome of the Cabal
summary: A warlock's work with the Tome of the Cabal now leads into hostile territory. After helping Jorah Annison restore the tome, you must claim three Rods of Channeling and bring them to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

sections.title: Secrets of the Reconstructed Tome
sections.body: In the Undercity, Jorah Annison studies the recovered fragments of the Tome of the Cabal. The Forsaken scholar pieces together its eldritch passages and welcomes the rare knowledge they offer. Then Jorah delivers an urgent directive from Strahad Farsan. Knowledge alone cannot bind a felhunter. A warlock needs precise instruments to focus demonic power into a binding circle.

sections.title: Venture into the Wetlands
sections.body: Strahad needs three Rods of Channeling, carried by renegade orcs of the Dragonmaw clan. They dwell among the ruins of Angerfang Encampment in the Wetlands, far from Horde lands. You must enter contested territory and face clan remnants who hate the modern Horde as much as they butcher Alliance explorers.

sections.title: Return to Ratchet
sections.body: With the rods and the Reconstructed Tome secured, you return across the sea to Strahad Farsan's tower above Ratchet. Strahad greets you with grim satisfaction. The ritual's components are assembled, and a dangerous test of will against a beast from the Twisting Nether lies ahead.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: what is tome of the cabal for
faq.answer: This is the third step in the Horde warlock chain to learn to summon a felhunter. You deliver the restored Tome of the Cabal and three Rods of Channeling to Strahad Farsan above Ratchet.

Jorah Annison is a Forsaken warlock and scholar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. Jorah studies esoteric and dark texts, helping fellow practitioners piece together shattered grimoires such as the Tome of the Cabal.

faq.q: Why are Rods of Channeling needed?
faq.answer: The rods give a warlock precise control when summoning and compelling a felhunter. They focus the ritual, stabilizing and shaping the summoning circle so the warlock can subdue the demon rather than be devoured.

faq.q: Where are the Dragonmaw orcs located for this quest?
faq.answer: The Dragonmaw clan holds Angerfang Encampment in the Wetlands, across the sea in Khaz Modan. Their bonewarders carry the channeling rods.
Strahad Farsan is a human warlock allied with the Horde's dark spellcasters. He works from a lone tower on the bluffs above Ratchet, the goblin port in the Barrens.

faq.q: What happens after completing this quest?
faq.answer: Your delivery leads into 'The Binding'. Strahad then instructs you to draw a summoning circle and face a summoned felhunter in magical combat to master the beast.

angles.text: As a warlock, you face a trial of resolve: securing dangerous ritual reagents in hostile lands takes the knowledge and nerve to bind a predatory felhunter to your service.
As a member of the Horde, you face Dragonmaw renegades in the Wetlands, bitter enemies of Thrall's Horde. Taking their channeling rods is a victory for Horde interests.
As an orc, striking down rogue Dragonmaw in the Wetlands recalls the dark, unrepentant path the Horde fought to leave behind.
As an undead, you can see Jorah Annison's work in the Undercity: Forsaken warlocks study forbidden arcane texts for practical supremacy.
